## Design result: no printable candidate found

I ran inverse design for the **600 mm high, 1.5 m long, two-filament wall** with a 25 mm nozzle, 50 mm/s speed, 60-minute open time, and the default 3DCP search space with OPC required.

The search sampled **4,096** mixes and found **zero** that met the full design criteria. It returned two relaxed candidates, but both were assessed as **non-printable**:

| Candidate | Mix | Predicted fresh properties | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Portland cement; w/b 0.335; s/b 2.93; PCE 0.18%; AD 0.36% | τs₀ 630 Pa; Athix 0.895 Pa/s | Plastic collapse by layer 7; buckling by layer 12 |
| 2 | Portland cement; w/b 0.336; s/b 1.06; PCE 0.17%; AD 0.20% | τs₀ 421 Pa; Athix 0.603 Pa/s | Plastic collapse by layer 4; buckling by layer 10 |

At the assumed 60 s layer cycle, the tool estimates the wall needs **τs ≈ 10.70 kPa at print completion**. Its candidates instead require minimum cycle times of **235 s** and **355 s**, while the 60-minute open-time limit allows at most **75 s** per layer. Thus, the default search found no feasible schedule for this job.

The tool used defaults of 12.5 mm layer height and 29.61 mm layer width. input.markdown:
# 600 mm wall: buildability assessment and mix design

## Job
Free straight wall, 600 mm high and 1.5 m long, two filaments, 25 mm nozzle, 50 mm/s, 60 min open time. Tool defaults: 12.5 mm layer height, 29.61 mm layer width, 60 s layer cycle (3,000 mm path / 50 mm/s), no dwell. Total print time: 48 min.

## Assessment using supplied fresh properties
Input: static yield stress 3.0 kPa and Athix 1 Pa/s. The physical verdict was **non-printable**, governed by elastic buckling; plastic collapse was also expected before reaching target height. The calculation predicted buckling at layer 17, plastic collapse at layer 34, and H_max 212.5 mm. Open time passed, but the schedule was infeasible: stability required at least 160.5 s per layer while open time allowed at most 75 s. At the current cycle, the reported requirements were approximately 7.82 kPa initial static yield stress or Athix 2.68 Pa/s. Consider bracing/closing the path, increasing build-up, or changing geometry and schedule; re-assess experimentally.

## Inverse design
Ran default 3DCP search space with OPC required. The engine sampled 4,096 mixes and found zero fully feasible candidates. Its two relaxed candidates were both **non-printable**:

| Candidate | Binder and ratios | Admixtures (binder %) | Predicted τs₀ | Predicted Athix | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Portland cement 1.00; w/b 0.335; s/b 2.93 | PCE 0.18%; AD 0.36% | 630 Pa | 0.895 Pa/s | Plastic collapse layer 7; buckling layer 12 |
| 2 | Portland cement 1.00; w/b 0.336; s/b 1.06 | PCE 0.17%; AD 0.20% | 421 Pa | 0.603 Pa/s | Plastic collapse layer 4; buckling layer 10 |

For the target schedule, the design tool estimated τs required at print completion as 10.70 kPa. Candidate minimum cycle times were 235 s and 355 s, both above the open-time cap of 75 s/layer. Therefore neither is a recommended production mix.

## Scope
These are model-based screening results from published-data correlations, not validated performance guarantees. Confirm any revised formulation and print schedule experimentally.
